expo.name: Workouts
expo._comment_userInterfaceStyle: Pinned dark, not automatic (#46): src/theme has one palette because the web app has one — there is no light scheme to fall back to, and 'automatic' would hand the OS a light keyboard and light sheet grabbers on a black app.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to scan food barcodes and find nutrition information.

expo._comment_locales: iOS reads its permission prompts from Info.plist, not from the JS message tree, so the camera purpose string has to be localized here or it stays English on a Dutch phone (#79). Android's permission dialog text is supplied by the system and cannot be set by the app; its Dutch equivalent is the in-app purpose line the scanner shows before asking, which comes from the message tree like everything else.
